responsibility: Implements path lookup for Rust AST name resolution. This file resolves expression paths, qualified expression paths, and simple paths by interpreting crate/self/super segments, consulting lexical name and type scopes plus module-child mappings, resolving generic arguments attached to segments, updating the final resolved name/type binding for both individual segments and whole paths, and issuing diagnostics for invalid path forms or unresolved segments.
same_name_distinction: Implements the concrete path lookup algorithms for expression, qualified-expression, and simple paths, handling crate/self/super segments, module-child traversal, scope fallback, generic-argument resolution, and unresolved-path diagnostics. Unlike the matching header, this file contains the actual segment-by-segment resolution logic.
